source.title: Conjectures and Refutations: The Growth of Scientific Knowledge

trace.notes: Mapped the PDF from the title page and contents. The only concentrated problem-oriented region is the appendix 'Some Problems in the Philosophy of Science' on pages 60-66, with additional scattered rhetorical questions elsewhere in the essays.

Reviewed the appendix and question-mark regions for explicit or implicit open problems. The source contains many discussions of philosophical problems and rhetorical questions, but it does not state extractable open or unsolved research questions with standalone technical problem content.

No candidates passed the open-question extraction gates because the identified passages are topical descriptions, solved-or-discussed problem areas, or rhetorical prompts rather than self-contained unsolved questions supported by problem-statement evidence.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/Popper-Conjectures-Rwefutations-GrowthOfKnowledge.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
